xtream.title: IPTV Codes
xtream.description: Home Assistant queries the Xtream Codes API of your provider.

data_description.notify_service: Optional: notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone) that receives the server, credentials and expiration once the account is added

stalker.title: IPTV Stalker (MAC address)
stalker.description: Home Assistant queries the Stalker/Ministra portal of your provider with a MAC address.

data_description.notify_service: Optional: notify service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone) that receives the server, credentials and expiration once the account is added

error.no_french_lists: No French list found on this provider (live, VOD or series categories): the account is not added.
error.french_unknown: Could not read the categories of this provider to check for French lists.

abort.migrated: {count} account(s) of the former IPTV Xtream integration moved to IPTV, with the same entities. Delete the old custom_components/iptv_xtream folder if it is still there and restart Home Assistant.
abort.account_updated: {title} is on the same server: the new account is valid longer ({new} instead of {current}), so {title} now uses the new credentials.
abort.existing_longer: {title} is on the same server and is valid longer or as long ({current}, new account: {new}): nothing changed.

data_description.notify_days: Persistent notification this many days before the subscription expires (0 to disable)
data_description.health_interval: How often the server is checked with a light request (account info only)
